text:
deploybot: Rollout v2.14.1 (slot 9) automatically paused: health checks failing (503/502) from eu-control-plane. Quarantine activated 07:42 UTC.
laura: ack. what's the observed impact (percent of traffic / services)?
ron: seeing elevated 5xxs from control-plane proxies, ~8% error rate across eu zones, spike started after a config push to token-proxy.
ops-oncall: investigating — token-proxy reports connection resets to internal token-svc. stack traces point to upstream timeouts. ETA 20m.
release-manager: do not trigger automatic rollback yet. we should pin the release to prevent partial rollout and notify stakeholders. deploy-admin can you pin and tag with incident?
deploy-admin: pinned v2.14.1 for slot 9: `deployctl pin --svc inference-api --ver v2.14.1 --slot 9 --note "hold/INC-8472 token-proxy"` Tagging ticket INC-8472.
paul: added deploy ticket annotation and created a short timeline in the release doc.
laura: thanks — we'll prepare rollback steps but hold execution until ops confirms app-level fault. also creating hotfix branch in case we need to revert a config: `hotfix/token-retry-2026-03-21`.
deploybot: Rollout paused; subsequent slots moved to pending. Canary traffic rerouted to last-known-good variant.
incident-bot: INC-8472 created: eu control-plane degradation (token-proxy -> token-svc). Mitigation work in progress. Next update in 10m.
ops-oncall: preliminary: seems upstream service had a connection pool exhaustion after recent scaling policy tweak. not seeing new exceptions in inference-api. leaning towards external cause.
ron: if it's external, reschedule remaining slots to the next maintenance window. what's the nearest window?
release-manager: maintenance window available 2026-03-22 01:00-04:00 UTC. proposal: reschedule remaining rollout to 2026-03-22 01:30 UTC with a 5% targeted canary at 01:00 UTC. leave slot 9 quarantined until post-canary verification.
paul: drafting customer notice: short note that scheduled rollouts may be delayed due to regional control-plane incident; linking INC-8472.
laura: preparing rollback command for SRE if needed:
```
# rollback to stable v2.13.9
deployctl rollback --service inference-api --from-version v2.14.1 --to-version v2.13.9 --force --reason "INC-8472"
```
deploy-admin: recorded rollback command in deploy ticket and added runbook pointer. also added tag `hold/INC-8472`.
ops-oncall: mitigation applied (increased token-svc pool + reset connections). metrics trending down, error rate back to baseline in last 5m. recommend: keep pin, run the pre-window 5% canary at 01:00 UTC as smoke, do not auto-unquarantine slot 9.
ron: agreed. we avoid unexpected customer changes overnight. reschedule sounds safer.
release-manager: confirmed. reschedule set: remaining slots -> 2026-03-22T01:30:00Z, pre-canary -> 2026-03-22T01:00:00Z (5%). assigned owners: @laura for pre-canary smoke, @paul for customer comms, @deploy-admin for pin management.
deploybot: Noted. Next retry for slot 10 moved to 2026-03-22T01:00:00Z (5% canary). slot 9 remains quarantined.
laura: i'll run focused smoke tests 30m before the pre-canary and post results here. if anything looks off, we abort and investigate further.
release-manager: add a short postmortem bullet in the release doc: cause hypothesis, decision to pin, rollback prep, reschedule window, canary plan. we'll expand after the canary.
incident-bot: INC-8472 updated: token-svc pool exhaustion mitigated; monitoring for regressions.
paul: customer blurb queued for 10:15 UTC: "Planned rollout for v2.14.1 delayed for EU regions due to control-plane incident. We'll run a targeted canary tomorrow 01:00 UTC and resume full rollout after verification. Link: INC-8472."
laura: thanks all. will post smoke-run results tomorrow morning. :thumbsup:
